title-screen.alt: The title screen on a near-black background with faint blue stars. "Pattern Break" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a row of small LED segments shading from green to red. Below it, a menu in small pixel type: "Play" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Practice" with "The_Epic_Chip", "Difficulty" with "Normal", and "Jukebox", in grey. Under the menu, "Music: The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain.", then "Up and down choose. Left and right change. Enter selects." At the bottom, a table of controls in dim grey: a header row "Fly, Fire, Bomb, Missile, Nuke, Buy, Boost, Pause", a "Keys" row "Arrows, Z, X, C, V, F, Shift, Esc", and a "Pad" row "Stick, A, B, RB, X, Y, LB, Start".
title-screen.caption: The title menu. Not used in the README.

gameplay.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern. Columns of small square LED segments hang from the top edge and rise from the bottom edge, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, leaving a dark passage across the middle. A small magenta and amber turret sits upside down on the tip of the ceiling at the right. A small cyan ship with a magenta engine flame flies on the left, with a row of cyan shots ahead of it and two short cyan shots angled up behind. In the middle, an amber capsule marked "P" floats beside a scatter of coloured particles where an enemy was just destroyed, with "200" in white pixel digits; another "200" and a "400" mark other kills. Three small ship icons on a dark panel in the top left corner show the lives left, followed by a small amber bomb icon and "x2" in amber; "0002800" in white in the top right corner is the score. Along the bottom edge runs the power-up meter, six LED cells labelled Boost, Double, Laser, Missile, Option and Shield: Boost and Double are lit bright green, the rest dark.
gameplay.caption: Pattern Break at 21.5 seconds into the test song on normal, with the ship flown by the autopilot.

gameplay-clip.alt: Four seconds of play in an LED cavern. Columns of square LED segments, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, hang from the top and rise from the bottom and scroll from right to left, one column per row of the song. Small magenta and amber turrets ride in on the tips of the floor and ceiling, and small magenta enemy ships fly in from the right and fire round magenta bullets. A small cyan ship on the left keeps firing cyan shots, some angled up, and moves up and down to dodge. Amber capsules marked "P" drift left along the middle of the cave. Three ship icons in the top left corner show the lives left, followed by a bomb icon, a cyan missile icon and "x3" in amber, and the score in the top right corner counts up as each kill shows its points where the enemy was, once "1200" in amber. Along the bottom edge runs the power-up meter, six LED cells labelled Boost, Double, Laser, Missile, Option and Shield, with Boost lit green.
gameplay-clip.caption: Four seconds of the test song on normal, flown by the autopilot through the sim.
